name: Richard Friedman
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Bremerton, Washington
about: Richard Friedman attended law school and graduated from Harvard Law School in 1979. Richard Friedman began practicing law in 1979.

Richard Friedman is an attorney at Friedman | Rubin PLLP, helping people with Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff issues. Friedman | Rubin PLLP has an office in Bremerton, Washington, serving the local community.

Richard Friedman was selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
